changeSet.sql: UPDATE llm_providers SET available_models = ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', elem, 'displayName', NULL)) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(available_models) AS elem ) WHERE available_models IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(available_models) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(available_models) > 0 AND jsonb_typeof(available_models -> 0) = 'string';
